title: Delayed Auditory Feedback EEG/EGG
description: This dataset contains simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) and electroglottography (EGG) recordings with audio collected during speech production under delayed auditory feedback. The audio channel holds the delayed feedback heard by the participant, and the EGG signal was minimally preprocessed to correct phase delays introduced by the amplifier hardware filter. Per-trial delay values in the events sidecar allow the speech waveform to be realigned to the time of production.
methods_description: EEG, EGG, and audio were digitized on the same hardware and stored together in the EEG files. EGG was minimally preprocessed by applying a software filter in the opposite temporal direction to correct phase delays from the amplifier's built-in hardware filter. Data were organized to the EEG-BIDS standard using MNE-BIDS.
